title: REL-4.8: Device Registry Release Notes
body:
Highlights

The Device Registry team ships REL-4.8 to every tenant on 5
May 2025. Highlights are faster search and a reworked admin
console, with Bluegate Networks contributing the search work
and 12 customer reports addressed.

Fixes

Fixes in this release, verified by Network Operations on 14
December 2025:
* Reduced memory use of the import service by a third
* Removed the deprecated bulk endpoint from the public API
* Fixed the pagination bug in the admin console lists

Upgrade notes

Tenants are upgraded automatically during the 03:30-05:00
UTC window; no action is needed. Release manager: Kenji
Sato; support contact: Omar Haddad, reachable through the
usual channel.
